title: Kushner, Netanyahu make little progress on advancing Gaza deal after meeting
summary_full: President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and envoy first held rare talks with Hamas’s new leader in Egypt over the weekend in his effort to advance the stalled 15-point plan.
